The kitchen features white cabinetry, a sink, and numerous festive wreaths and golden miniature trees. (2) The woman performs micro-expressions, smiling brightly while placing her hands near her cheeks in a playful gesture. She turns her body 45 degrees to the left and right, maintaining the dance flow. The background lighting is warm and bright, coming from a window with white blinds behind her. (3) She raises both arms above her head, performing more expansive sweeping motions. Her facial expressions remain cheerful and high-energy. The camera remains mostly static, capturing her from the mid-thigh up. Golden Christmas ornaments and lush green garlands are visible on the countertops. (4) The woman leans slightly toward the camera with a playful smile, then retreats to continue her hip-swaying routine. She performs a series of rhythmic hand-claps and finger-points toward the lens. The scene remains consistently bright and festive throughout the entire sequence.
